verdict.rationale: Resend documents an SMTP relay at smtp.resend.com on ports 25, 465, 587, 2465 and 2587. It uses username `resend` and an API key as the password, and those keys are generated through the documented API-key creation flow, which can be scoped to sending-only and to a single domain. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SMTP sending, and documentation of SMTP-specific details such as TLS behavior, limits, and framework or legacy-app setup examples.
